title: Operating Rules for Payouts on the Paystride Instant Pay Disbursement Service
content:
## Section 1 — When a payout may be sent

1.1 A payout on the Paystride Instant Pay Disbursement Service is sent only while the service status is active.

1.2 A payout is sent only for a disbursement type listed among the kinds of pay the service's tier permits.

1.3 Each payout pays one worker who is on the employer's payroll file when the tier requires every payee to be a current worker, the worker being identified by the worker's profile and employee number.

The status, the tier and the kind of pay are read from Paystride's records of this service and this payout before the payout is sent.

## Section 2 — Available money

2.1 A payout is sent only from available prefund money: it may not exceed the prefund balance, ACH deposits count only once the tier's ACH availability period in business days after receipt has passed, and the balance never goes below zero.

## Section 3 — Limits

3.1 A payout is at most the tier's largest single disbursement, at most the tier's largest instant payout to an external debit card when it goes to an external debit card, and at most the largest same-day ACH entry when it goes by same-day ACH.

3.2 The day's payouts — the total of the service's payouts booked that Eastern Time calendar day — may not exceed the tier's daily disbursement limit. One worker's payouts may not exceed the tier's per-worker daily amount or per-worker daily number of payouts in a day — the total and the count of payouts to that worker that day — or the tier's per-worker monthly amount in a calendar month — the total of payouts to that worker in the month.

3.3 A payout over any limit is not sent and is never split by the desk.

## Section 4 — Speed and settlement

4.1 Payouts to a Paystride card or an external debit card are instant, every day when the tier runs instant payouts every day of the year.

4.2 Payouts to a bank account go by same-day ACH and settle the next business day when requested after the tier's same-day ACH cutoff or on a non-business day.

## Section 5 — Nature of the pay

5.1 Pay sent this way is the employer's own payroll payment: Paystride does not advance it and does not recover it from the worker's wages.

5.2 A payout's sequence number for the day is one more than the payouts already booked that day.

## Worked limit check (hypothetical figures)

On a tier whose per-worker daily amount were 800.00, a worker already paid 650.00 today could not receive a payout of 200.00, because 650.00 plus 200.00 is 850.00, more than 800.00; the payout is not sent and is not split into a smaller payout. A payout of 150.00 brings the day's total for that worker to exactly 800.00 and does not exceed the amount.

| Payout requested to the bank account | Settles |
|---|---|
| On a business day after the cutoff | the next business day |
| On a non-business day | the next business day |
